crossRefs.note: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t…
Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the…
I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in…
But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…
On the first day of every week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

translations.web: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
translations.bsb: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you come together it will not result in judgment. And when I come, I will give instructions about the remaining matters.
translations.kjv: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ➔ ye come ➔ not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
translations.asv: If any man is hungry, let him eat at home; that your coming together be not unto judgment. And the rest will I set in order whensoever I come.
